descripcion: Mixture of refined saturated hydrocarbons of petrochemical origin, colorless, odorless and tasteless in appearance. It is used as an emollient, lubricant and inert oily vehicle in cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, veterinary products and cleaning products, and as an aid in industrial and food applications in accordance with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Vehicle for ointments and topical preparations
Release and coating agent, in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Clear, colorless oily liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Family of volatile aromatic concentrates of plant origin, obtained by steam distillation or by pressing of citrus fruits. They provide the aroma and characteristic notes of each species, and are used as aromatic components in cosmetics, foods, supplements, and pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations, depending on the reference and applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Volatile liquid of variable color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Family of oils obtained by pressing or extraction of seeds and fruits, a source of triglycerides and fatty acids. In foods they are used as a cooking medium, dressing base and formulation fat; in other industries they are used as emollients and fatty material. Their properties depend on the species and on the refining process.
formas_referenciales: Oily liquid, pale yellow to amber in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Short-chain organic acid in its concentrated form, used as an acidulant, pH regulator and, once diluted, a preservative. In the chemical and textile industries it is used as a mordant and as a synthesis raw material, and in cleaning as an acid descaler. Its handling requires the precautions appropriate to a concentrated product.
aplicaciones: Preparation of vinegars and sauces by dilution
pH adjustment in cosmetics and cleaning products
Synthesis of acetates and other derivatives
formas_referenciales: Colorless liquid with a pungent odor that may solidify at cool temperatures, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Aromatic carboxylic acid used as a preservative with antimicrobial and antifungal action, performing better in acidic media. It is used in cosmetic formulations, foods, and pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations, generally combined with its salts, in accordance with the usage limits of applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: White crystalline solid — crystals, flakes or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Carboxylic acid with an aldehyde group, used in cosmetic hair-smoothing formulations, where it interacts with the protein structure of the hair. It is also a synthesis intermediate for other chemical compounds. Its use in cosmetics is subject to the limits and conditions set by applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to yellowish aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Aqueous solution of sodium hyaluronate, a humectant biopolymer with a high water-retention capacity. Its liquid form makes incorporation into the aqueous phase easier without needing to hydrate the powder. It is used in serums, gels and other aqueous skin care formulations, as well as in pharmaceutical, veterinary and nutraceutical preparations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to slightly opalescent aqueous solution, viscosity depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Sodium salt of hyaluronic acid in powder form, a humectant biopolymer obtained by fermentation, in its medium molecular weight variant. It retains water on the surface of the skin and provides a feeling of hydration with good spreadability. It is used in cosmetic serums, creams and gels, as well as in supplements and pharmaceutical preparations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine white to cream powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Pyrone derivative obtained by fermentation of fungi of the genus Aspergillus, which inhibits the enzyme tyrosinase. It is used as an active in cosmetic formulations associated with skin tone uniformity and the appearance of spots, and as an input in dermatological preparations for pharmaceutical use.
formas_referenciales: White to cream crystalline solid — powder or crystals, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Strong inorganic acid and oxidizer, used in the pickling and passivation of metals and in the acid cleaning of surfaces and equipment. It is also a raw material for chemical synthesis. It must be handled with the controls appropriate to a concentrated acid and in accordance with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Pickling and passivation of stainless steel
formas_referenciales: Colorless to yellowish liquid, aqueous solution with a concentration depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Short-chain dicarboxylic acid capable of forming complexes with metals such as iron. It is used as a rust and stain remover, a wood and textile bleach, and an auxiliary in industrial purification processes. Its handling requires the precautions appropriate to a toxic and irritant acid.
formas_referenciales: White crystalline solid — crystals or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Dicarboxylic organic acid naturally present in grapes and other fruits, commonly obtained from winemaking residues. It is used as an acidulant, pH regulator and metal chelator, with a synergistic antioxidant effect. It is common in beverages, confectionery, baking powders and effervescent formulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to white crystalline solid — crystals or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Organic acid with a thiol group, with reducing properties that break the disulfide bonds of keratin. It is used in hair perm solutions and chemical depilatories, and in industry as a corrosion inhibitor and a raw material for thioglycolates. It requires careful handling because of its intense odor and corrosive nature.
formas_referenciales: Colorless liquid with an intense characteristic odor, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Hydrophilic fumed silica with a very fine particle size, used as a thixotropic agent, thickener, anticaking agent and matting agent in liquids and powders. It provides flowability to powder blends and structure to gels and suspensions, with uses in cosmetics, household care, pharmaceuticals, veterinary, nutraceuticals and foods.
formas_referenciales: Solid — very fine, fluffy white powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Aromatic crystalline compound with a penetrating odor, obtained from the camphor tree or by synthesis from terpenes. It is used in topical formulations to provide aroma and a cooling sensation, and as a component of ointments, liniments and balsamic products for external use. Its use is subject to concentration limits depending on the sector.
aplicaciones: Ointments and liniments for external use
Fragrances and aromatization in authorized uses
formas_referenciales: White, translucent crystalline solid with a penetrating odor, depending on the manufacturer and batch; sublimes at room temperature

descripcion: Aromatic alcohol with a faint odor, used as a preservative with antimicrobial activity and as a solvent in cosmetics, fragrances, cleaning products and pharmaceutical and veterinary formulations, including injectables. It is also used as a solvent in industrial applications and, in accordance with applicable regulations, as a flavoring in foods.
formas_referenciales: Colorless liquid with a mild aromatic odor, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Long-chain saturated fatty alcohol used as a co-emulsifier and consistency agent in emulsions. It provides body, richness and stability to creams, lotions and conditioners, and is also used in pharmaceutical and veterinary bases, cleaning products and industrial applications. Its use in foods and nutraceuticals depends on applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Ointments and pharmaceutical or veterinary bases
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes, beads or pastilles, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Ethanol to which denaturants are added to make it unfit for human consumption, used as a solvent and vehicle in hydroalcoholic formulas. It is a common base for surface disinfectants and cleaning products, and is also used in cosmetics, pharmaceutical and veterinary formulations for external use, and industrial processes. The denaturant and the ethanol content depend on the supplier.
formas_referenciales: Colorless, volatile and flammable liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Ethanol of agricultural origin, rectified to achieve a neutral odor profile. It is used as a solvent and vehicle in perfumery and cosmetics, in the extraction of botanical material and in pharmaceutical, veterinary, cleaning and industrial formulations. Its use in foods and nutraceuticals depends on the grade and applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless, volatile and flammable liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble synthetic polymer obtained by hydrolysis of polyvinyl acetate, used as a film former, adhesive and dispersion stabilizer. It is used in peel-off masks, pharmaceutical coatings, adhesives and water-soluble films. Its properties depend on the degree of hydrolysis and the molecular weight.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, white to cream in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble polysaccharide extracted from brown algae, which forms gels on contact with calcium ions. It is used as a thickener, gelling agent and colloidal film former in cosmetics, cleaning products, and pharmaceutical, veterinary and nutraceutical preparations, with a performance that depends on the grade and viscosity.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine white to cream powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Polysaccharide extracted from corn kernels, composed of amylose and amylopectin. It is used as a thickener, binder and absorbent agent in cosmetic powders, tablets and capsules, foods and household care products, as well as in industrial applications such as adhesives and textile starching.
aplicaciones: Household care products and textile starching
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine white powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Silicone with amino groups that adheres to hair and textile fibers, providing softness, ease of combing and a long-lasting silky feel. It is commonly used as an emulsion in conditioners, hair masks, conditioning shampoos and fabric softeners, and is associated with frizz control.
formas_referenciales: Liquid or emulsion — viscosity and appearance vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Family of compounds with a positively charged quaternary nitrogen and alkyl chains, acting as cationic surfactants. They are used as antimicrobial agents in surface and facility disinfectants, in cleaning and industrial products, and some types are used in cosmetics as conditioners. Their properties depend on the structure and the specific grade.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to yellowish liquid, in aqueous or alcoholic solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Semi-essential basic amino acid present in proteins of animal and plant origin. It is used in cosmetic formulations as a pH adjuster and skin and hair conditioner, and as an amino acid contribution in supplements, foods, animal nutrition and pharmaceutical products. In nutrition it is associated with nitric oxide metabolism.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Sodium salt of ascorbic acid, a form of vitamin C with lower acidity than the free acid. It is used as an antioxidant in foods and beverages, as a source of vitamin C in supplements, and in pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations, in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: White to slightly yellowish crystalline solid — powder or crystals, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Cationic emulsifying base, pre-formulated for making hair conditioners, masks and detangling balms. It allows working with few additional ingredients, such as fragrance, actives and preservative, and reduces formula development time. It is also used in animal coat care products.
formas_referenciales: Waxy solid or cream, white in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Soap base with glycerin, available in a translucent or white version, which is melted and poured into molds to make handmade soaps and cleansing bars. It allows the incorporation of fragrances, colorants and additives, and does not require the saponification process. It is also used in pet soaps and hand-cleaning soaps.
formas_referenciales: Solid — translucent or white blocks or bars, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Versatile pre-formulated emulsion that serves as a vehicle to incorporate actives, fragrances and oils in the making of facial and body creams. It avoids formulating the emulsion from scratch, simplifies manufacturing and allows the final product to be customized. It is also used in veterinary care products.
aplicaciones: Creams with incorporated actives and oils
formas_referenciales: Semi-solid cream, white in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Concentrated base made from cationic agents for manufacturing household fabric softeners. It is diluted in water and completed with fragrance and colorant, which simplifies making the final product. It provides softness to fibers and reduces static electricity in clothing, depending on the formulation.
formas_referenciales: Paste or viscous liquid, white to cream in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Mineral clay rich in montmorillonite that swells and forms colloidal dispersions when hydrated. It provides viscosity and stability to suspensions, masks and cleaners, and is also used in pharmaceutical and veterinary formulations and in industrial applications such as drilling muds and binders.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine powder, cream to light gray in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Organic ultraviolet filter of the benzophenone family, used in cosmetic formulations to absorb broad-spectrum UV radiation. It is used in sunscreens and in skin and hair care products that require photoprotection of the product itself.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to pale yellowish crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Combination of two fat-soluble synthetic phenolic antioxidants, butylhydroxyanisole and butylhydroxytoluene, which act in a complementary way. They are used to delay oxidation and rancidity of fats, oils and the formulations that contain them, protecting the stability of cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, veterinary products and supplements.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or crystalline flakes, white to yellowish in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Diluted preparation of biotin (vitamin B7), a water-soluble vitamin of the B complex. In cosmetics it is used in formulations for hair and nail care, such as tonics and shampoos; in nutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals and veterinary products it is used as a source of vitamin B7 in liquid preparations, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — solution, colorless to yellowish, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Biotin (vitamin B7) in powder form, a water-soluble vitamin of the B complex associated with macronutrient metabolism and the maintenance of skin, hair and nails, in line with applicable regulations. It is used in supplements, vitamin premixes, pharmaceutical formulations and cosmetic products for hair care.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to off-white crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: White clay composed mainly of hydrated aluminum silicate, with fine particle size. It is used as an adsorbent and mattifying base in talcs and masks, as a filler and diluent in tablets, and as a bulking agent in household care and industrial products.
aplicaciones: Household care products and mild abrasives
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine white to off-white powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Cross-linked acrylic polymer used as a rheology modifier, easily dispersible in water. After neutralization or pH adjustment it forms gels and provides body and particle suspension in gels, emulsions, household care products and topical pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations.
aplicaciones: Thickened cleaners and household care products
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Inorganic magnesium salt, light and of low solubility in water, used as a pH regulator, drying agent and anticaking agent. It is used as a mineral source in supplements, as an excipient in tablets and as an absorbent in cosmetic powders, as well as in foods, household care and industry in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — light white powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Alkaline inorganic salt, highly soluble in water, used as a potassium source and acidity regulator. It is used to adjust pH in cosmetic and household care formulations, as an alkalizing agent in foods and in the manufacture of soaps, glass and other industrial processes.
aplicaciones: pH adjustment in cosmetics and household care
Alkalizing agent in foods in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Solid — hygroscopic white powder or granules depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: High-viscosity hydroxyethylcellulose, a water-soluble nonionic cellulose ether, used as a thickener and water retention agent. It provides rheological control and stability in gels, household care cleaners, industrial formulations and topical veterinary products, and its high viscosity allows thickening at low dosages.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to cream powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Purified, partially depolymerized cellulose in the form of a fine powder, used as a binder, bulking agent and anticaking agent. It is used in cosmetics, household care, veterinary, industry and foods to give body, compact powder blends, improve the texture of pressed products and stabilize suspensions.
aplicaciones: Household care products in powder or tablet form
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine white powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Wax of synthetic composition that reproduces the structuring function of beeswax, with a more uniform melting point. It is used in modeling waxes, lipsticks, balms and stick products, as well as in ointment bases. Its use in foods depends on the grade and applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes, pellets or blocks, white to yellowish in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Vegetable wax obtained by hydrogenation of soybean oil, biodegradable and soft to the touch. It is used as a consistency agent and emollient in balms, sticks and creams, and as a base or consistency agent in pharmaceutical, veterinary and nutraceutical formulations. Its use in foods depends on the grade and applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes or pellets, white to cream in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Hydrocarbon-type mineral wax from the refining of ozokerite, a natural fossil wax. It is used to adjust the consistency and hardness of stick products and anhydrous systems, and as a consistency agent in ointments and pharmaceutical and veterinary bases. Its use in foods and nutraceuticals depends on applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes, pellets or blocks, white to yellowish in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Wax of synthetic origin used to adjust the hardness and viscosity of stick products and anhydrous systems. It provides structure and stability to balms, ointments and pomades, and its properties depend on the type of wax and its melting point. Its use in foods and nutraceuticals depends on the grade and applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes, pellets or powder, white to cream in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Family of ethoxylated cetostearyl alcohols, hydrophilic nonionic emulsifiers that differ in their degree of ethoxylation (25, 30 or 50 moles of ethylene oxide). They are used to stabilize oil-in-water emulsions and solubilize oil phases in creams, lotions and cleaning products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — waxy flakes, pearls or granules depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Low-viscosity volatile cyclic silicone that evaporates after application, leaving a light, dry feel. It is used as a vehicle and sensory modifier in cosmetics, hair care and cleaning products, and as a volatile solvent in technical formulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless, volatile liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Calcium salt of citric acid used as a source of calcium and as a mineral stabilizer and acidity regulator. It is used in supplements, fortified foods and pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations, and in cosmetics as a buffering agent, in line with applicable regulations. It is an alternative to other calcium salts when a mineral supply is sought in solid or liquid formulations.
aplicaciones: Calcium supplements in powder, tablet and capsule form
formas_referenciales: Solid — white powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Magnesium salt of citric acid used as a source of magnesium in supplements, foods and pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations. It also acts as an acidity regulator and, in cosmetics, as a buffering agent, in line with applicable regulations. It is an alternative to other magnesium salts when a mineral supply is sought in solid or liquid formulations.
aplicaciones: Mineral supplements in powder, tablet and capsule form
formas_referenciales: Solid — white powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Potassium salt of citric acid used as a pH regulator and buffering agent in foods, beverages and pharmaceutical preparations. It is also used as a source of potassium in supplements and veterinary formulations, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Sodium salt of citric acid used as an acidity regulator, buffering agent and emulsifying salt. It is used in foods and beverages, in pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations and, in cosmetics, to adjust pH and sequester metal ions, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystalline powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Inorganic aluminum salt used as an astringent agent and antiperspirant active in cosmetic deodorants and antiperspirants. It is incorporated in formats such as roll-on, stick, aerosol and cream, where it helps reduce the perception of moisture in the area of application. Its use is subject to applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Highly hygroscopic inorganic salt, used as a drying and dehumidifying agent. Depending on the application, it is also used as a source of calcium, firming agent and processing aid in foods and as an electrolyte in pharmaceutical, veterinary and cosmetic formulations, in line with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Firming agent and processing aid in foods
formas_referenciales: Solid — white flakes, pearls or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on availability

descripcion: Basic mineral salt used to adjust the salinity and tonicity of formulations and as a source of electrolytes. In foods it is used as a seasoning and preservation aid, and in cosmetics it allows the viscosity of surfactant systems to be adjusted, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystals or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Inorganic zinc salt, hygroscopic and highly soluble in water, used as a source of zinc and associated with astringent properties. It is used in oral care formulations, pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations, mineral supplements and other technical applications, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Amphoteric surfactant derived from coconut, of the amphoacetate family, with a mild profile and good compatibility with anionic surfactants. It provides stable foam and improves the tolerance of the formula, which is why it is used in shampoos, liquid soaps, facial cleansers and hygiene products.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — yellowish aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Fat-soluble quinone-type compound naturally present in cells, used as an antioxidant in anti-aging cosmetic formulations and in nutritional supplements. In cosmetics it is incorporated into the oil phase of creams and serums; in oral products it is used in capsules and supplements. It is light-sensitive, so it should be protected in packaging.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder, yellow to orange in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Protein obtained by enzymatic hydrolysis of collagen, made up of low molecular weight peptides and rich in amino acids such as glycine, proline and hydroxyproline. It is water-soluble and is used as a protein ingredient in supplements, foods and animal nutrition, and as a conditioner and humectant in cosmetics.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine powder, white to cream in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Natural solid resin obtained from the oleoresin of pine trees, composed mainly of resin acids. It is used as a tackifying agent and film former in depilatory waxes, adhesives and patches, and as a component of soaps, inks, varnishes and other industrial products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — brittle glassy pieces, amber to yellow in color, or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Family of water-soluble and pigment colorants intended to color products in different sectors: cosmetics, beverages, confectionery, capsules and tablets, household cleaners and industrial applications. The appropriate grade depends on the sector and on the list of authorized colorants applicable to each use.
aplicaciones: Beverages and confectionery in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, or liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Glycosaminoglycan naturally present in connective tissue and cartilage, generally obtained from animal sources. It is used in supplements formulated for joint care, in veterinary products and, in cosmetics, as a moisturizing ingredient, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to cream powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Non-ionic solubilizer obtained by ethoxylation of hydrogenated castor oil, used to disperse essential oils, fragrances and oil-soluble actives in water. It is used in colognes, tonics, air fresheners and cleaning products, as well as in pharmaceutical, veterinary and nutraceutical formulations, according to applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Solubilization of fragrances and essential oils
formas_referenciales: Paste or viscous yellowish liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Concentrated phenol-based disinfectant, normally an emulsifiable mixture of cresols and phenols, which is diluted in water before use. It is used for the disinfection of floors, surfaces, stables, corrals and animal handling areas. Its exact composition varies between manufacturers and must be verified in the technical data sheet.
formas_referenciales: Dark liquid, brown to amber, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Cross-linked sodium carboxymethylcellulose, a cellulose-derived polymer that swells rapidly on contact with water without dissolving. It is used as a superdisintegrant in pharmaceutical and veterinary tablets and capsules, and in dietary supplement tablets in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white, fibrous powder with variable flow, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Monocyclic terpene obtained mainly from citrus peel that provides a characteristic citrus aroma. It is used as a degreasing solvent in cleaning products and as an aromatic component in cleaning and cosmetic formulations. It is of renewable origin and biodegradable.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to pale yellow liquid, citrus odor, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Peptide-type active aimed at anti-aging dermocosmetics, used in formulations associated with skin firmness and elasticity and with antioxidant protection. It is used in serums, creams and eye contour products for specialized care. The manufacturer's technical data sheet defines its composition and conditions of use.
formas_referenciales: Liquid or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Hair care complex described as a film former with a repolarizing action on the fiber. It is used in formulations that seek to improve the manageability, softness and appearance of the hair, and in styling products with a light-hold effect. Its composition is confirmed in the manufacturer's technical data sheet.
formas_referenciales: Liquid or viscous gel, depending on the manufacturer and batch

sinonimos: Hair straightener free of formaldehyde releasers
descripcion: Hair active based on carbocysteine, a sulfur-containing derivative of cysteine, used in hair-smoothing and conditioning formulations. It is proposed as an alternative to systems with formaldehyde releasers and is applied in treatments combined with heat. Its performance depends on the formulation and the application procedure.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, or liquid in solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Amorphous silica with a very fine particle size and high specific surface area. It is used as an anticaking agent and glidant in powders, as a thickener in liquid and semisolid systems, and as an absorbent in cosmetic, pharmaceutical, veterinary, household care and food formulations in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white amorphous powder, very fine and of low density, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Inorganic white pigment in the anatase crystalline form, valued for its covering power and opacifying capacity. It is used in cosmetics, household care products, paints and plastics for industrial use and in coatings of nutraceutical solid forms, according to the specifications of each application.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine white powder, particle size and surface treatment vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Low-volatility glycol, miscible with water, used as a solvent and carrier for fragrances and essential oils. It is used in perfumery, cosmetics, air fresheners and cleaners, and as a coupling solvent in industrial formulations. It is a widely used mixture of isomers when a low-odor solvent is sought that is compatible with many raw materials and easy to handle in the plant.
formas_referenciales: Colorless liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Broad-spectrum preservative that acts as a formaldehyde releaser, active against bacteria and fungi in water-based formulations. It is used in shampoos, creams, gels and cleaning products, and in topical veterinary products.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to pale yellow liquid (aqueous solution) or solid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Preservative system that combines DMDM hydantoin, a formaldehyde releaser, with IPBC (iodopropynyl butylcarbamate), a fungicide with complementary action. The combination is used to protect against bacteria, yeasts and molds in cosmetics, cleaning products and topical veterinary products.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to pale yellow liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Aqueous dispersion of silicone oil stabilized with emulsifiers, easy to dilute in water. It is used as a base for tire and vinyl polishes, as a mold release agent and in automotive care formulations and industrial applications for lubrication and surface protection.
formas_referenciales: Milky white liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Calcium salt of stearic acid, insoluble in water, used as a lubricant and anti-sticking agent. It improves the flow of powders and facilitates the compression of tablets and capsules. In cosmetics it is used in powders and pressed products to improve slip, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine white powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Potassium salt of stearic acid that acts as a mild soap and emulsifier. It is used as an input in liquid soaps, shaving creams and emulsions, and as a co-emulsifier in pharmaceutical and veterinary topical preparations, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, flakes or paste, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Sodium salt of stearic acid that acts as a soap, thickener and gelling agent for fatty phases. It is used as a structuring base to give solid consistency to sticks and gels, and as a component of soaps and topical preparations, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white powder or flakes, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Metallic salt of stearic acid, hydrophobic and insoluble in water, used as a lubricant and anti-sticking agent. In cosmetics it provides slip and adhesion to pressed powders and eyeshadows; in pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals it is used as a lubricant in tablet compression, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine white powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Oil-soluble organic ultraviolet filter, with absorption mainly in the UVB region, widely used in photoprotection. It is incorporated in sunscreens, creams and lotions for daily use, and may also be used in topical pharmaceutical preparations that require a UV filter, in combination with other filters.
aplicaciones: Facial creams and lotions with SPF
formas_referenciales: Colorless to pale yellow oily liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Cyclic monoterpene (ether) naturally present in eucalyptus essential oil, with a fresh camphoraceous aroma. It is used as an aromatic and cooling component in cosmetics and cleaning products, in formulations for topical respiratory use and as a flavoring in foods, within the limits of applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless liquid, camphoraceous aroma, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Family of concentrates obtained from plants by extraction with solvents such as water, glycols or ethanol, which gather compounds of the source species. They are used as natural-trend ingredients in cosmetics, cleaning, nutraceuticals, and pharmaceutical and veterinary formulations. Each reference is defined by its species, plant part and extraction method.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — glycolic, hydroalcoholic or aqueous, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Solid — dry powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Fine starch obtained from corn kernels, commercially known as maizena. It is used as a binder and sebum absorbent in cosmetic talcs and powders, as a thickener in baking and sauces, as an excipient in pharmaceutical and veterinary forms, and in textile starching.
aplicaciones: Textile starching and household care products
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine white powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Hydroxylated aromatic compound that occurs as a crystalline solid, used as a chemical intermediate in the synthesis of phenolic resins, disinfectants and reagents for the pharmaceutical industry. It is a substance requiring specialized handling. Its use in cosmetics and veterinary products is subject to applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to pinkish crystalline solid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Ready-to-use blend of phenoxyethanol and ethylhexylglycerin, used as a broad-spectrum preservative system. Ethylhexylglycerin acts as a booster of antimicrobial protection and adds softness to the formula. It is used in cosmetics, cleaning products and other aqueous formulations, within the limits of applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to slightly yellowish liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Concentrated olfactory compositions, made from synthetic or natural notes, that provide aroma to finished products. They are used in perfumery, cosmetics and personal care, and in household care products such as disinfectants, air fresheners and scented candles.
formas_referenciales: Transparent liquid, colorless to amber, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Synthetic polycyclic musk (HHCB) with a sweet, clean, musky aroma and long-lasting persistence. It is used as a fixative and as a base component in fine fragrance compositions, cosmetics, detergents, fabric softeners and other household care products, and in scented industrial applications. Its aromatic profile and low volatility favor the persistence of the fragrance.
aplicaciones: Air fresheners and scented industrial applications
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid, colorless to yellowish, depending on the manufacturer and batch; may be supplied diluted

descripcion: Solid soap base with a high content of vegetable-origin glycerin, ready to melt, color and scent. It is used in the artisanal and industrial production of toilet soaps, decorative soaps and cleansing bars, and accepts fragrances, botanical extracts and other additives.
formas_referenciales: Solid — blocks or bars, transparent or opaque, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Mild anionic surfactant derived from the amino acid glycine and fatty acids (acylglycinate type), used as a low-irritation cleansing and foaming agent. It is used in facial cleansers, shampoos, shower gels, pet hygiene products and cleaning products. It is often combined with amphoteric surfactants to achieve creamy-foam formulas with good tolerance.
formas_referenciales: Liquid or paste, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Reflective particles or flakes of variable sizes and colors, used for decorative purposes to provide visual shine. They are incorporated in makeup, body and hair gels, soaps and bath products, and in other items where a sparkling effect is sought.
formas_referenciales: Solid — particles or flakes of variable sizes and colors depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Non-ionic thickener based on an ethoxylated methyl glucose diester, derived from corn glucose. It adds viscosity to surfactant systems and is associated with mild-profile formulas. It is used in shampoos, shower gels, facial cleansers and liquid soaps.
formas_referenciales: Waxy solid, flakes or liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Salt of the biguanide chlorhexidine with gluconic acid, usually handled in aqueous solution and acting as a broad-spectrum antimicrobial agent. It is used in antiseptics, disinfectants, hand and surface hygiene, mouthwashes and, where regulations allow, as a preservative in cosmetic products.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to pale yellow liquid (aqueous solution), depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Amino sugar derived from glucose that is marketed as a sulfate salt, generally stabilized with sodium or potassium chloride. It is a precursor in the biosynthesis of glycosaminoglycans and is used in dietary supplements aimed at joint maintenance. Its use is governed by applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Aromatic phenolic compound (2-methoxyphenol) that presents as an oily liquid with a characteristic odor. It is used as a raw material in pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations, particularly in formulations associated with the respiratory tract, and as an intermediate in the synthesis of other aromatic compounds.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to yellowish aromatic liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch; may solidify at cool temperatures

descripcion: Astringent aluminum salt used as an antiperspirant active in deodorants of various formats. In industrial applications it is used as a coagulant and flocculant, for example in water treatment, and its use in each sector is governed by applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Roll-on, spray and stick deodorants and antiperspirants
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Urea derivative with a hydroxyethyl group, used as a humectant in skin care formulations. It provides hydration with a non-greasy, non-sticky feel and is compatible with a wide range of cosmetic systems. It is used in creams, lotions and serums, and in veterinary dermal care products.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to yellowish viscous liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble nonionic cellulose ether, obtained from plant cellulose, which acts as a thickener, film former and binder. It is used in cosmetics, household care products, industrial applications such as mortars and adhesives, and in veterinary and nutraceutical formulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to cream powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Ultra-high-viscosity hydroxyethylcellulose, a water-soluble nonionic cellulose ether, used as a thickener and water retention agent. It allows body to be achieved at low dosages in household care products and in industrial formulations such as water-based paints and thickened fluids.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to cream powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: High-viscosity hydroxyethylcellulose, a water-soluble nonionic cellulose ether, used as a thickener and water retention agent. It provides body and stability in household care products and in industrial formulations such as water-based paints and thickened fluids.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to cream powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Cyclic polyol with a slightly sweet taste, naturally present in plants and tissues and historically known as a B-complex vitamin. It is used in supplements and animal nutrition, and in cosmetic formulations for hair and skin care.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystalline powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Storage polysaccharide made up of fructose units, extracted mainly from chicory or agave root. It is used as a prebiotic-type fiber in supplements and animal nutrition, and in cosmetics as a skin conditioner in natural-trend skin care formulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Soy extract rich in isoflavones, including genistein and daidzein, polyphenols with a structure similar to plant estrogens. It is used in cosmetics associated with the appearance of skin firmness and antioxidant protection, and in nutritional supplements, according to applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine powder, beige to pale yellow, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Branched-chain glycol (3-methyl-1,3-butanediol), used as a humectant and solvent in cosmetic formulations. It provides a soft, silky feel, helps solubilize actives and contributes to the performance of preservative systems. It is used in creams, serums and toners, and in cleaning products and topical pharmaceutical and veterinary products.
formas_referenciales: Colorless, slightly viscous liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Broad-spectrum biocide and preservative based on isothiazolinones, supplied as a concentrate to be dosed at very low levels. It is used for microbial control in detergents, aqueous cleaners and water-based industrial systems, in line with applicable regulations. It requires dilution and careful handling because it is a concentrated product.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — transparent to slightly yellow, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Aqueous solution of peptides and amino acids obtained by hydrolysis of keratin, easy to incorporate in the aqueous phase. It is used in conditioners, shampoos and hair treatments as a conditioning ingredient associated with strengthening the fiber, and in animal coat care products.
formas_referenciales: Amber to yellowish liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Protein obtained by hydrolysis of keratin, presented as a water-soluble powder. It is used as a conditioning and repairing ingredient in shampoos, conditioners and hair treatments, associated with strengthening the fiber, and in animal coat care products and nutraceutical formulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, cream to yellowish in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Synthetic compound of the imidazole family, with antifungal activity, considered a pharmaceutical active ingredient. It is used in topical formulations, such as shampoos and creams, and in products for veterinary use, always in accordance with applicable regulations and health registration.
formas_referenciales: Solid — crystalline powder, white to cream in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Amino acid-derived compound that the body synthesizes from lysine and methionine and that takes part in fatty acid transport. It is used as a nutritional ingredient in supplements, foods and animal nutrition, and in cosmetics in body gels and creams.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystalline powder, hygroscopic, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Calcium salt of lactic acid used as a source of calcium and as an acidity regulator. It is used in supplements, fortified foods and beverages, pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations and, in cosmetics, as a buffering agent, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Magnesium salt of lactic acid used as a source of magnesium in supplements, foods and pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations. It is also used as an acidity regulator and to supply electrolytes, and in cosmetics as a buffering agent, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Potassium salt of lactic acid used as a pH regulator and moisture preservative. In foods, especially meat products, it is used as an antimicrobial aid; in cosmetics and pharmaceuticals it acts as a humectant and buffering agent, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to slightly yellowish aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Sodium salt of lactic acid, a humectant of physiological origin present in the skin's natural moisturizing factor. It is also used as a buffering agent to regulate pH in cosmetics, foods and pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to slightly yellowish aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Zinc salt of lactic acid used as a source of zinc and associated with astringent properties. It is used in oral care and skin care formulations, in mineral supplements and in foods and pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Waxy fat obtained from sheep wool, free of water, composed of esters of fatty acids and high molecular weight alcohols. It is used as an emollient and hydrophobic protectant in balms, creams and ointments, and as a base in topical pharmaceutical and veterinary formulations.
formas_referenciales: Semisolid — unctuous paste, yellow to amber in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Anionic surfactant obtained by ethoxylation and sulfation of lauryl alcohol, widely used as a primary surfactant for its abundant foam and good performance in hard water. It is incorporated into shampoos, liquid soaps, dishwashing liquids and detergents, and is often combined with amphoteric surfactants to adjust the mildness profile of the formula.
formas_referenciales: Paste or viscous liquid, colorless to yellowish, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Non-ionic surfactant of the alkyl polyglucoside group, made from coconut fatty alcohols and corn-derived glucose. It provides mild cleansing, foam and ready biodegradability. It is used in shampoos, facial and body cleansers, baby products and eco-profile household cleaners.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid or aqueous paste, colorless to yellowish, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Mixture of phospholipids obtained from sunflower seeds, a plant-based emulsifier that is an alternative to soy lecithin. It facilitates the integration of fatty and aqueous phases and is used as a dispersant in confectionery, bakery, supplements and cosmetic and pharmaceutical formulations.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid, amber to brown in color, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Solid — de-oiled powder or granules depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Pharmaceutical active ingredient of the amide family, used as a local anesthetic in topical formulations such as gels, creams, ointments and patches. In its free base form it is poorly soluble in water and dissolves better in fatty or alcoholic media. Its handling and use are subject to health regulation.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Polyol with a slightly sweet taste and low hygroscopicity, used as an excipient, diluent and bulking agent in tablets and powders, and as a sweetener and bulking agent in foods and supplements. Its stability against moisture makes it useful in solid formulations.
aplicaciones: Confectionery and foods in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystalline powder or granules depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Cyclic terpene alcohol obtained from mint essential oils or by synthesis, presented as crystals with a minty aroma and cooling effect. It is used as a cooling-sensation agent in cosmetics, hygiene and topical formulations, and as a flavoring in foods and nutraceutical products, within the limits of applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — colorless crystals, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Methyl ester of 4-hydroxybenzoic acid used as a broad-spectrum antimicrobial preservative, with activity against fungi and yeasts. It is used in cosmetic, pharmaceutical, veterinary, nutraceutical and cleaning formulations, and in some foods, within the limits of applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Sodium salt of methylparaben, water-soluble, used as an antimicrobial preservative in aqueous formulations. It makes it easy to incorporate the preservative into the aqueous phase without prior heating or dissolving. It is used in cosmetics, cleaning products, pharmaceuticals, veterinary products, nutraceuticals and foods, within the limits of applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white hygroscopic powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Pharmaceutical active ingredient derived from pyrimidine, used in solutions, foams and other topical forms for hair use. It is a drug whose use corresponds to formulations made by authorized laboratories, under applicable health regulation. It occurs as a crystalline solid soluble in alcohols and glycols.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to cream crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Oxygenated solvent of the ether-alcohol family, with low odor and controlled evaporation, miscible with water. It is used as a solvent and coalescent in fragrances, air fresheners and household cleaners, and as a cosolvent in personal care formulations. Its relatively low volatility profile makes it possible to modulate evaporation and improve fragrance diffusion in the formula.
formas_referenciales: Colorless liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Blend of glyceryl monostearate and PEG-100 stearate, a nonionic self-emulsifying base for oil-in-water emulsions. It provides stability and body in cosmetic and dermal creams and lotions, and allows emulsification without an additional co-emulsifier in many formulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — waxy flakes, pearls or granules depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Primary alkanolamine of alkaline character, used as a neutralizer and pH regulator in formulations. It forms salts with fatty acids and with acidic anionic surfactants, and is therefore used in cleaners, detergents and personal care products. In industry it is also used in working fluids and in acid gas capture processes.
aplicaciones: Neutralization of fatty acids and surfactants
formas_referenciales: Colorless viscous liquid with an ammoniacal odor, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Polar aprotic solvent miscible with water and with most organic solvents, with high dissolving power for resins and polymers. It is used in chemical extraction, paint and coating removers, industrial cleaners and as a cosolvent in technical formulations. Owing to its toxicity and the regulatory restrictions that affect it, its use must be carefully evaluated against alternatives and current regulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to yellowish liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Liquid pearlizing dispersion based on glycol distearate (EGDS), used to give a pearly and opaque appearance to liquid formulations. It is incorporated in shampoos, liquid soaps, shower gels and household care products, with the advantage of not requiring heating in the process.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid, white to milky, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Long-chain branched fatty alcohol (Guerbet type), liquid at room temperature and stable against hydrolysis. It is used as a non-greasy emollient and as a solvent for pigments and lipophilic actives in creams, lipsticks and other formulations with a soft finish. It is also used as a lubricant and finishing component in household care and industrial formulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to yellowish oily liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Opacifying polymer dispersion that gives liquid formulations a white, milky appearance by scattering light. It is used in liquid detergents, household cleaners and institutional and industrial cleaning products, where it improves the visual presentation of the finished product.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — milky white dispersion, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Inorganic copper (II) oxide in the form of a black to brown powder, used as a pigment and as a mineral source of copper. It is used in ceramics, glazes and enamels, catalysts and electronic components, and as a source of copper in supplement formulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — black to brown powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Amine oxide-type surfactant derived from coconut fatty amines, of amphiphilic character. It boosts and stabilizes foam and adds viscosity in systems with anionic surfactants, and is used in hypochlorite formulations owing to its compatibility. It is used in household and surface cleaners, dishwashing liquids and personal care products.
formas_referenciales: Aqueous liquid, transparent to slightly hazy, colorless to yellowish, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Inorganic mineral compound in the form of a white powder, used in cosmetics as an absorbent, bulking agent and mild opacifier, as well as an alkaline regulator in some formulations. It is used in facial powders, makeup and powder products; in the matrix it is also associated with pharmaceutical and chemical uses.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white powder, light or heavy, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Fatty ester of palmitic acid and isopropanol, with low viscosity and a dry feel. It is used as a light emollient in dry oils, facial creams and makeup removers, and as a vehicle or solvent for lipophilic actives and pigments in various formulations. It promotes easy spreading and a non-greasy finish.
aplicaciones: Lubricant and solvent in industrial applications
formas_referenciales: Colorless to slightly yellowish oily liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Mixture of saturated hydrocarbons of mineral origin, obtained from petroleum refining, which presents as a solid wax. It is used as a structuring and consistency agent in creams, ointments and sticks, and as a base material for candles, polishes and insulating coatings in industrial applications.
formas_referenciales: Solid — blocks, flakes or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Mixture of polydeoxyribonucleotides obtained by extraction and purification of DNA of marine origin, usually from salmonids. It is used in anti-aging cosmetic formulations, associated with the appearance of comfort and firmness of the skin. Its use in veterinary and nutraceutical products depends on applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to beige lyophilized powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Silicone modified with polyethylene glycol chains, soluble or dispersible in water, which combines the silky feel of silicones with affinity for aqueous systems. It is used as a conditioner, sensory emollient and surface wetting agent in hair care, skin care and cleaning products.
formas_referenciales: Transparent to slightly hazy liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Nonionic ester of polyethylene glycol and stearic acid, used as a thickener and rheology modifier in surfactant systems. It provides viscosity and stability to shampoos, shower gels and cleaners, and is used in cosmetics, household care and topical veterinary products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to cream waxy flakes or pearls, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Family of short chains of amino acids, obtained by synthesis or by biotechnological processes, used as actives in anti-aging cosmetics. They are associated with the appearance of skin firmness and elasticity and with the visual reduction of expression lines. Each peptide is defined by its sequence and its INCI name.
aplicaciones: Facial creams and eye contour products
Supplements and veterinary care, according to regulations
formas_referenciales: Solid — lyophilized powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous or glycolic solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Phenylated silicone with a high refractive index, compatible with oils and organic emollients, providing shine and a silky, non-greasy feel. It is used in hair care, makeup and skin care products, and in pet hygiene formulas.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to slightly yellowish liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Porous volcanic rock of mineral origin, composed mainly of aluminosilicates, which is ground into powders of different particle sizes. It is used as a mild abrasive in exfoliants and cleansing pastes, and as a cleaning and polishing abrasive in cleaning products and industrial applications.
formas_referenciales: Solid — light gray to off-white powder, particle size depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Coordination complex of zinc with pyrithione, with antimicrobial and antifungal activity, used in shampoos and scalp care products for dandruff-prone scalps. It is practically insoluble in water and is incorporated as a micronized powder or as an aqueous dispersion.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to cream powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous dispersion, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Liquid polymer of ethylene oxide, water-soluble and of low volatility. It is used as a vehicle, solvent and humectant in pharmaceutical and cosmetic formulations, and as a plasticizer and carrier in inks and other industrial applications.
formas_referenciales: Colorless viscous liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Solid polymer of ethylene oxide, water-soluble and of high molecular weight, available in flakes. It is used as a binder and lubricant in tablets, as a solubilizer and base in solid systems, and as a component of waxes and powder formulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Ethoxylated hydrogenated castor oil derivative, marketed under the trade name PEG 6000. It works as a nonionic solubilizer and emulsifier, useful for incorporating fragrances and essential oils into aqueous media.
formas_referenciales: Liquid or viscous paste, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Nonionic surfactant obtained by ethoxylation of sorbitan esters with lauric acid. It acts as a solubilizer of essential oils, fragrances and oil-soluble actives in aqueous media, and as an oil-in-water emulsifier in cosmetic, pharmaceutical, veterinary, household care and food formulations, in accordance with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Solubilization of fragrances and essential oils
formas_referenciales: Yellowish viscous liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Hydrophilic nonionic emulsifier derived from sorbitol, stearic acid and ethylene oxide. It is used to stabilize oil-in-water emulsions in thick cosmetic creams and lotions, and as an emulsifying additive in foods in accordance with applicable regulations. It also acts as a solubilizer and dispersant in pharmaceutical, veterinary and household care formulations.
aplicaciones: Emulsified foods in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid or waxy semisolid, yellowish to amber, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Nonionic triblock copolymer of polyoxyethylene and polyoxypropylene, whose concentrated aqueous solutions form thermoreversible gels as the temperature increases. It is used as a gelling agent and solubilizer of lipophilic actives and fragrances in cosmetic, pharmaceutical and veterinary formulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes, pearls or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Cationic polymer derived from hydroxyethylcellulose modified with quaternary ammonium groups. It deposits on hair and skin and provides conditioning, ease of combing and a soft feel, in addition to contributing to texture and foam stability. It is used in shampoos, conditioners, shower gels and cleansers.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to cream granular powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

sinonimos: Quaternized copolymer of vinylpyrrolidone and dimethylaminoethyl methacrylate
descripcion: Cationic copolymer of vinylpyrrolidone and dimethylaminoethyl methacrylate quaternized with diethyl sulfate. It forms clear, flexible films and provides conditioning. It is used in hair fixatives, styling gels and mousses and conditioners, and in other personal care products, with good compatibility in aqueous systems.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — viscous aqueous solution, transparent to slightly amber, depending on the manufacturer and batch

sinonimos: Copolymer of acrylic acid and diallyldimethylammonium chloride
descripcion: Water-soluble copolymer of acrylic acid and diallyldimethylammonium chloride, of amphoteric character. It provides conditioning and a soft feel and contributes to foam stability, with good compatibility with anionic surfactants. It is used in shampoos, shower gels and personal care cleansers.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — viscous aqueous solution, colorless to slightly yellowish, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble cationic polymer, a homopolymer of diallyldimethylammonium chloride, used as a conditioner in personal care products. It improves combability and the feeling of softness in shampoos and other rinse-off products, and also has industrial uses as a coagulant and flocculant.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — colorless to yellowish aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Propyl ester of 4-hydroxybenzoic acid, a fat-soluble antimicrobial preservative with activity against fungi and yeasts. It is often combined with methylparaben to broaden the spectrum of protection. It is used in creams, emulsions and pharmaceutical and veterinary preparations, within the limits of applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Sodium salt of propylparaben, water-soluble, used as an antimicrobial preservative in aqueous formulations. It allows the preservative to be incorporated directly into the aqueous phase and is often combined with methylparaben. It is used in cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and veterinary products, within the limits of applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Medium-molecular-weight polyvinylpyrrolidone (K30 grade), a water-soluble synthetic polymer. It forms flexible, clear films and acts as a binder and dispersing or suspending agent. It is used in hair fixatives, tablets and granulates, suspensions and cleaner additives, where it contributes to dispersion and film formation.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to cream powder, hygroscopic, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Synthetic polymer soluble in water and alcohols, of high molecular mass and high viscosity, used as a fixative and film former. It provides strong hold in hair gels and serves as a binder in pharmaceutical and veterinary formulations and as an additive in household care products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to cream powder, hygroscopic, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Family of flavorings and essences that provide or modify the flavor profile of a product. They are used in beverages, syrups, confectionery and oral formulations, and, depending on the grade, also in oral care products and other uses, in accordance with the applicable regulations of each industry.
formas_referenciales: Liquid or powder, depending on the grade, manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Synthetic non-caloric high-intensity sweetener, derived from saccharin and with good water solubility. It is used to sweeten foods and diet beverages, syrups and pharmaceutical and veterinary oral formulations, and to mask flavors in oral care products, in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white powder or crystals, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Methyl ester of salicylic acid, a liquid with a characteristic wintergreen odor. It is used as a flavoring and as a component of topical formulations associated with a localized warming sensation, in cosmetic products and in pharmaceutical and veterinary products, in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless to yellowish liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Anionic surfactant derived from the amino acid sarcosine and coconut fatty acids, with a mild profile and abundant, creamy foam. It is used in shampoos, shower gels, facial cleansers, shaving foams and toothpastes, and in hygiene products for veterinary use.
formas_referenciales: Transparent liquid, colorless to pale yellow, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Polydimethylsiloxane fluid of medium nominal viscosity, close to 350 cSt, chemically inert. It provides shine, hydrophobic protection and lubrication in cosmetics, hair care and cleaning products, and is used as a lubricant and mold release agent in industrial, veterinary and pharmaceutical applications according to applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Industrial lubricants and mold release agents
formas_referenciales: Transparent, colorless liquid, viscosity depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Ester of sorbitan and stearic acid, a lipophilic nonionic emulsifier with low HLB. It is used to prepare water-in-oil emulsions and as a co-emulsifier together with polysorbates in dense creams, ointments and other cosmetic, pharmaceutical and food formulations, in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Waxy solid — pearls or flakes, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Ester of sorbitan and oleic acid, a liquid lipophilic nonionic emulsifier with low HLB. It is used to prepare inverse and water-in-oil emulsions, and as a co-emulsifier in cutting fluids, agrochemical formulations and cosmetic creams.
formas_referenciales: Amber viscous liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Filamentous blue-green microalga of the genus Arthrospira, recognized for its content of proteins, chlorophyll, phycocyanin and other pigments and antioxidants. It is used as a nutrition and supplementation ingredient in animal feed formulations, for example in pet supplements, premixes and balanced diets, according to applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Feed for birds and ornamental fish
formas_referenciales: Solid — bluish-green to dark green powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble inorganic cobalt salt, usually found as a hydrate. It is used as a source of cobalt (micronutrient) in mineral premixes for animal nutrition, and as an input in electroplating baths, ceramic pigments and driers for paints and varnishes. Its handling requires precautions owing to the toxicological characteristics of cobalt salts, so the applicable regulations are verified for each use.
formas_referenciales: Crystalline solid, reddish to pink, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Iron(II) salt used as a source of iron in nutritional supplements and premixes for animal nutrition. It is also used in water treatment as a coagulant and reducing agent, and in the manufacture of dyes and pigments. It is commonly sold as the heptahydrate or in dry form.
formas_referenciales: Bluish-green crystalline solid or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Inorganic sodium salt with reducing and antioxidant character. It is used as a dechlorinating agent and oxygen scavenger in water treatment, as an antioxidant preservative in foods and as an auxiliary in tanning and other industrial processes, according to applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white powder or crystals, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Micronized hydrated magnesium silicate mineral with a lamellar structure, providing lubricity, moisture absorption and opacity. It is used as a filler and extender in paints, plastics and household care products, and as a diluent in powders, depending on the grade and the manufacturer's documentation.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white micronized powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Organic rheology modifier with thixotropic action, used to give body to liquid systems and prevent sagging and settling of pigments and fillers. It is used in paints, coatings and resins for industrial use, where it helps maintain system stability during storage and application.
formas_referenciales: Solid — fine or micronized powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Non-reducing disaccharide formed by two glucose molecules, naturally present in fungi, yeasts and some plants. It is used as a humectant in cosmetics and as a stabilizer of proteins and other biomolecules in pharmaceutical and biotechnological formulations, in addition to industrial stabilization applications.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Solvent that the company describes as obtained from pine resin, with a characteristic odor and rich in terpenes. It is used as a thinner for oil paints and varnishes, as a component of floor waxes and polishes, and as a synthesis raw material.
aplicaciones: Thinner for oil paints and varnishes
formas_referenciales: Colorless to yellowish liquid with a pine odor, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Tertiary alkanolamine of alkaline character, used as a pH regulator and neutralizer of carbomer polymers. When reacting with fatty acids it forms salts with emulsifying action, and is therefore used in creams, gels, detergents and cleaners, and also in industrial fluids.
aplicaciones: Neutralization of carbomers in gels and creams
pH adjustment in cosmetics and household care
formas_referenciales: Colorless to yellowish viscous liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Tertiary alkanolamine of alkaline character, used as a pH regulator and neutralizer. It is used to neutralize carbomer polymers and acids in gels, creams, cleaners and detergents, in topical formulations for pharmaceutical use and in industrial applications, in accordance with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Neutralization of carbomers in gels and creams
pH adjustment in cosmetics and household care
formas_referenciales: Colorless to yellowish viscous liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Purified mixture of semisolid hydrocarbons of mineral origin, obtained from petroleum refining. It is used for its emollient and occlusive properties as a base for ointments, salves, balms and creams, and as a lubricant and surface protectant in industrial and household care applications.
formas_referenciales: Unctuous semisolid, white to yellowish, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Magnesium aluminum silicate, a high-viscosity purified smectite clay that hydrates in water to form colloidal dispersions. It is used to suspend particles and stabilize emulsions in cosmetics and in liquid and semisolid pharmaceutical formulations, where it provides body and uniformity.
formas_referenciales: Solid — cream to white powder or flakes, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Magnesium aluminum silicate of mineral origin, of the colloidal type, which hydrates in water and provides a creamy texture and stability. It is used in lotions, creams and suspensions for cosmetic and pharmaceutical use as a thickener and stabilizer.
formas_referenciales: Solid — cream to white powder or flakes, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Ester of retinol with palmitic acid, a fat-soluble form of vitamin A. It is used in cosmetic formulations for skin care, associated with its antioxidant action, and as a source of vitamin A in supplements, fortified foods, veterinary premixes and pharmaceutical preparations, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Viscous oily yellow liquid, or stabilized powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Hydrochloride salt of thiamine, a water-soluble vitamin of the B complex associated with energy metabolism, in line with applicable regulations. It is used as a source of vitamin B1 in nutritional supplements, fortified foods, pharmaceutical formulations and veterinary premixes, and to a lesser extent in cosmetic products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to off-white crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble form of vitamin B12 that contains cobalt, associated with cellular metabolism and the formation of red blood cells, in line with applicable regulations. It is used as a source of vitamin B12 in supplements, fortified foods, veterinary premixes and pharmaceutical formulations, and in some cosmetic skin products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — dark red powder or crystals, or triturate diluted on a carrier, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble vitamin of the B complex that acts as a cofactor in amino acid metabolism, in line with applicable regulations. It is used as a source of vitamin B6 in dietary supplements, fortified foods, pharmaceutical formulations and veterinary premixes, and in lotions and hair products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to off-white crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) with a coating layer that limits its exposure to moisture, heat and oxidation during processing and storage. It is used as a source of vitamin C and antioxidant in foods, tablets, supplements and premixes, and in powder or anhydrous cosmetic formulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to off-white powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: L-ascorbic acid in crystalline powder form, a water-soluble vitamin that dissolves rapidly in water. It is used as a source of vitamin C and antioxidant in beverages and effervescent tablets, supplements, pharmaceutical formulations and veterinary premixes, and in aqueous-phase cosmetic serums. Its use in each industry is governed by applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white to pale yellowish crystalline powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Form of vitamin E modified or formulated to dissolve or disperse in water, which facilitates its direct incorporation into aqueous phases. It is used as a source of vitamin E and antioxidant in aqueous cosmetic formulations, beverages, supplements and liquid pharmaceutical preparations, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid, waxy paste or dispersible powder, amber to yellow, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Powdered preparation of vitamin E adsorbed or microdispersed on a carrier, which facilitates its dosing and homogeneous mixing in powders. It is used as a source of vitamin E and antioxidant in nutritional powders, hard capsules, tablets and premixes, and in powder cosmetic products, in line with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — free-flowing white to cream powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Aromatic hydrocarbon solvent, usually a mixture of dimethylbenzene isomers, with high dissolving and degreasing power. It is used as a thinner for paints, varnishes and resins, in synthesis processes and as a clearing agent in laboratory histological techniques.
formas_referenciales: Colorless liquid with an aromatic odor, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Five-carbon polyol used as a sweetener and humectant, with a cooling sensation when dissolving. It is used in toothpastes and mouthwashes, pharmaceutical oral formulations and personal care products, in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystals or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Inorganic salt of potassium and iodine, soluble in water, used as a source of iodine. It is used in pharmaceutical formulations, nutritional supplements, animal nutrition premixes and as a reagent in analytical chemistry, in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — white crystals or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Zinc salt of pyrrolidone carboxylic acid (PCA), used in cosmetics as an active for the care of combination and oily skin, associated with shine control and a balanced appearance of the skin. funciones: Active for combination to oily skin
aplicaciones: Serums and gels for combination to oily skin
